title: 第16章 车窗里的蜡烛第17章 抱公鸡的女孩
lines: 客厅里伸手不见五指。
所有会发光的电器设备都被丢弃，能投射光亮的窗户也被遮挡得严严实实。
苏午在如此漆黑的客厅里行走，依然闲庭信步。
由于黑暗行者天赋的存在，黑暗对他的视力影响已经很小。
他走进卧室，在书桌前坐下。
扫视四周的墙壁，可以看到墙壁上渐渐生出了青绿色的霉斑，一些淡黄色水渍痕迹亦开始在墙上浮现。
诡异正在悄无声息地侵蚀这里。
书桌上，放着一个背包。
记事本、食物、水、药品、蜡烛、香烟、一把强光手电、帝钟、罡洞、黄金等重要物品都在这个背包里。
苏午从包里取出帝钟、手电，把新买来的粗瓷碗放进包里，将生出些许裂痕的罡洞依旧压在最下面。
这根人骨骨笛里的诡异已经与影诡融合成‘尸陀鬼之手’，正在模拟器的出售清单里。
或许是因为没有了诡异的支撑，其上开始显现裂痕。
它现在对于苏午的唯一作用，就是开启其主人过去人生。
只要不影响它的这个作用，品相再差，苏午都不会在意。
一手握帝钟，兜里揣着红蜡烛，他打开了模拟器。
“欢迎来到完美人生模拟器！”
“你的钱包元玉余额为670，个人人生模拟消耗1元玉……”
“是否消耗元玉，将现实物品带到模拟游戏中？”
前面数次模拟，通关影诡区域已经不再获得基础评分奖励，只有成功躲避影诡追杀可以获得奖励。
如此元玉增减下来，目前苏午钱包里还有670个元玉。
他留意了一下可带出的物品选项，看到自己刚买到的粗瓷碗浮现其上。
选项6：做工拙劣的近代粗瓷大碗。
确实如摊主所言，瓷碗是近代的旧物件。
苏午没有选择将这件物品带入模拟，而是看向了表盘四周浮现的四块屏幕。
第一块屏幕里显示他坐在书桌前，选定这个场景，他会从自己的房间里开始未来模拟；
第二块屏幕里显示他坐在小庙里，这是一个存档点。
第三块与第四块屏幕都是黑漆漆的一片，前者是罡洞主人的过去人生，开启需要花费500元玉；
后者是粗瓷碗主人的过去人生，开启需要花费100元玉。
目光在四块屏幕上稍微停留，苏午的注意力聚集向第二块屏幕——小庙存档点。
“载入天赋中……”
“载入游戏中……”
“你的未来人生已载入成功！”
黑暗徐徐散去。
小庙里，灯台上的火焰无声无息地燃烧着，橘色的暖光扩散到了庙外。
苏午背靠墙壁，平息下脑海里的眩晕感，就从地上爬起。
他手里拿着帝钟，兜里还揣了一把红蜡烛。
把东西暂时放在一边，他捡起上一次放在地上的记事本与手机翻了翻，二者记录的内容都没有丝毫变化。
13号时霉斑产生；
14号平安花苑里发生三起凶杀案，在3号单元楼；
15号楼上的小情侣死亡，群里进来了神秘人，通知民众隔断光源，自己的住处开始变得不安全。
此前苏午从租住的房间开局，模拟几次到达小庙这个存档点，每一次翻阅的日记内容都没有变化，跟这次一模一样。
但他第一次进入模拟时，看到的记事本记录内容，所有事件发生的日期都与当前大相径庭。
content_en:
There was no room for sight in the living room.
All electrical appliances that emit light have been discarded, and windows that project light are tightly blocked.
Su Wu walked in such a dark living room, still strolling leisurely.
Due to the Dark Walker's talent, darkness has very little impact on his vision.
He walked into the bedroom and sat down at the desk.
Scanning the surrounding walls, you can see that green mold spots are gradually growing on the walls, and some light yellow water stains are also beginning to appear on the walls.
Weirdness is quietly eroding this place.
There is a backpack on the desk.
Important items such as notepad, food, water, medicine, candles, cigarettes, a strong flashlight, imperial clock, Gang Cave, gold, etc. are all in this backpack.
Su Wu took out the imperial clock and flashlight from the bag, and put the newly purchased coarse porcelain bowl into the bag, keeping the slightly cracked hole at the bottom.
The weirdness in this human bone flute has been merged with the shadow to form the 'Ghost Hand', which is now on the simulator's sales list.
Perhaps because there was no weird support, cracks began to appear on it.
Its only function for Su Wu now is to open up its owner's past life.
As long as it doesn't affect its function, Su Wu won't care no matter how bad the quality is.
Holding the imperial clock in one hand and a red candle in his pocket, he turned on the simulator.
"Welcome to Perfect Life Simulator!"
"The balance of your wallet Yuanyu is 670, and the personal life simulation consumes 1 Yuanyu..."
"Should Yuan Yu be consumed to bring real-life items into the simulation game?"
In the previous simulations, you will no longer receive basic score rewards for clearing the Shadow Creed area. You can only obtain rewards by successfully evading the pursuit of Shadow Creed.
After increasing or decreasing Yuan Yu in this way, Su Wu currently still has 670 Yuan Yu in his wallet.
He paid attention to the items that could be taken out and saw the stoneware bowl he just bought appearing on it.
Option 6: A large modern stoneware bowl with poor workmanship.
Indeed, as the stall owner said, the porcelain bowl is an old object from modern times.
Su Wu did not choose to bring this item into the simulation, but looked at the four screens emerging around the dial.
The first screen shows him sitting at his desk, selecting this scene, and he will start the future simulation from his room;
The second screen shows him sitting in a small temple, which is a save point.
The third and fourth screens are both pitch black. The former is the past life of the owner of Gangdong. It costs 500 yuan to open;
The latter is the past life of the owner of the coarse porcelain bowl, and it costs 100 yuan to open it.
His eyes lingered on the four screens for a while, and Su Wu focused his attention on the second screen - the Xiaomiao save point.
"Loading talent..."
"Loading into the game..."
"Your future life is already loaded with success!"
The darkness slowly dissipated.
In the small temple, the flame on the lampstand burned silently, and the orange warm light spread outside the temple.
Su Wu leaned against the wall, calmed down the dizziness in his mind, and got up from the ground.
He held the imperial clock in his hand and a handful of red candles in his pocket.
Putting the things aside for the time being, he picked up the notepad and mobile phone that he had put on the ground last time and flipped through them. The contents of both records had not changed at all.
Mildew appeared on the 13th;
Three murders occurred in No. 14 Ping An Garden, in unit building No. 3;
The young couple on the 15th floor died, and a mysterious person came into the group, informing the public to cut off the light source, and their residence began to become unsafe.
Previously, Su Wu started from the rented room and simulated arriving at the archive point of Xiaomiao several times. The contents of the diary that he read did not change each time and were exactly the same as this time.
But when he first entered the simulation, he saw the contents of the notepad, and the dates of all events were very different from the current date.
